text:
maria: Heads up — Starlit Supplies invoice 60721 landed in AP with no PO. Uploaded PDF to billing@redwood.com, shows up as 'no po'. Can someone route approver? Looks like ENG infra spend. 🙏

devin: Amount?

maria: $12,450.00 — billed for runtime GPU hours and 2x support seats. invoice link: https://files.redwood.com/invoices/60721.pdf

maria: ```
Invoice: 60721
Vendor: Starlit Supplies
Amount: $12,450.00
PO: -
Lines:
  - GPU hours 10,984.00
  - Support seats 1,466.00
GL: 5021
```

vikram: @maria can you confirm this is for the runtime infra project (cost center ENG-INFRA)? If yes I can approve but need PO number.

asha: Searching procurement — vendor usually references PO 80021 for support but attachment looks like different header. @oliver can you check vendor portal?

oliver: Vendor portal shows invoice 60721 attached to PO 80021 but amounts mismatch. Vendor notes 'credit not applied'. I DM'd Starlit to reissue or confirm credit.

finance-bot: ScanBot: invoice 60721 flagged -> missing PO link. Ticket AP-4357 created.

devin: If vendor reissues with PO 80021 we can auto-match and route to @vikram. Otherwise AP needs manual approval.

maria: I attached OCR extract — OCR failed to pick up PO field. Link: https://files.redwood.com/ocr/60721.json

vikram: OK, I'll approve provisional charge under cost center ENG-INFRA while we wait on vendor reissue. @finance-bot can you set hold = 'pending credit confirmation' and route approval to me? :thumbsup:

finance-bot: AP-4357 updated: provisional approver = vikram, hold = pending_credit, notify = devin,maria

maria: Thanks. I'll follow up with procurement and vendor, will mark ticket resolved after credit applied.
